name: GitHub
one_liner: Code hosting platform exposing repositories, pull requests, issues, and Actions through REST and GraphQL APIs.
auth_notes: Requestly listing gives auth type oauth2. Official auth docs are not in the pages.
access_notes: Third-party listing: free with rate limits; GitHub subscription not required for API access. Official pricing page not in the pages.

buildability.rationale: Third-party listing shows free self-serve access, REST and GraphQL APIs, and oauth2 auth. Official docs are not in the pages, so verify before building.

identity.quote: Access GitHub's platform to manage repositories, pull requests, issues, actions, and more through comprehensive REST and GraphQL APIs.

access.quote: Free with rate limits (5,000 requests/hour for authenticated users). GitHub subscription not required for API access.

api_surface.quote: through comprehensive REST and GraphQL APIs.
5000 requests per hour (authenticated); 60 requests per hour (unauthenticated).

mcp.quote: The GitHub MCP Server connects AI tools directly to GitHub, allowing AI agents and assistants to interact with your repositories via natural language.

needs_human_reason: Official API docs, auth scopes, pricing, and MCP ownership are not in the pages. Verify on docs.github.com and the official pricing page.
